text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! If it isn't Jordan. You out shopping 
too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Pokke, aren't your nails wrecked?! 
They look like they're about to split!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, maybe. My toenails look pretty 
much like that too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Usually, my Trainer or my pals would be 
fussing all over me. Well, leave it alone 
and it'll heal on its own.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like hell! Especially not your toenails! 
Come here, I'm doing your nails!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, put your foot out. Got any requests 
for the design?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Beats me. Well, just make sure you pull it 
off in style.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. Alright, guess it's time to go 
wild child.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And to finish it off, apply the top 
coat... Alright, whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, look! It says "Battle 
Screams" right here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Your nickname is the "Fiery Screaming 
Demon," right? Pretty stylish, don'tcha 
think?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Whoa, whoa, whoa! This is way too 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll treasure these nails! Seriously, 
thanks, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're way too hyped up, it's hilarious. 
...Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I don't feel like I'd lose any 
race! Is this the power of nail art...?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You like it that much? Then I'll pile on 
even more!

Perhaps because she had broken new ground, 
Jungle Pocket's senses became even sharper 
from that day forward.
